reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Gate 3 triggered: the entire attack path requires the Legion admin (onlyLegion modifier) to deliberately call setAcceptedCapital() with a malicious Merkle root after publishSaleResults(). No untrusted party can reach this code path. Exploiting this is exclusively a privileged-admin action, which falls squarely under 'Centralization risks' — explicitly listed in out_of_scope in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json. Gate 1 passed (public API exception: function is external virtual in ILegionAbstractSale interface). Gate 2 not applicable (no trust_assumptions field present).
